ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Highly skewed toward low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels forming the base substrate (~85% of surface), with high-intensity (white) focal clusters (~15% of surface) providing high local contrast.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Widespread distribution of high-contrast white focal points across both lobes. Discrete white contiguous patches are observed at the left distal margin. Numerous annular (ring-shaped) white pixel clusters are concentrated in the mid-right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central notch with an approximate interior angle of 60 degrees. The vertex depth is significant, roughly 1/6th of the total visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Complex, high-frequency serration along the entire boundary. Pixel-amplitude variations (peaks and valleys) range from 3 to 15 pixels in depth, creating a jagged profile against the water spray background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward and outward trajectory. The trailing edge follows a concave curve from the median notch, transitioning to a convex sweep toward the dorsal-pointing tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High density of roughly circular, high-contrast white pixel clusters (5-20 pixels in diameter). Many appear as distinct rings, particularly dense on the medial and distal right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, non-parallel white linear streaks (rake marks) are visible; most prominent are a group of diagonal disruptions on the mid-right lobe and singular horizontal marks on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy biological encrustation (barnacles) visible as high-intensity, textured white clusters concentrated on the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: A unique 'chain' of overlapping white circular scars is visible on the central-right lobe, forming a distinct geometric pattern identifiable at this resolution.
